33213-the-fun-of-cooking-a-story-for-gir.title: A Story For Boys And Girls
33213-the-fun-of-cooking-a-story-for-gir.creator: Caroline French Benton
33213-the-fun-of-cooking-a-story-for-gir.description: A book by Caroline French Benton. The Blairs were a particularly nice family. That is what the neighbors always said of them, and, to tell the truth, the Blairs believed it. That is, the father and mother thought the children were particularly nice, and the children thought their father and mother and each other particularly nice; and so, of course, they all must have been very nice indeed.

73220-gangway-for-homer.title: Gangway For Homer
73220-gangway-for-homer.creator: Unknown
73220-gangway-for-homer.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Had you ever listened to President Soupy remarking that such and such was "taken on a Zeiss Super Iconta B with Metchnormatic Ultra-Lite film at an exposure of f5.6 with diaphragm--, etc.," you too would have been gay--aye, insanely gay--to have had him interrupted by a luscious looking pair of legs like that. Thus, everybody was happy.

arxiv-2104-05706.title: Towards Efficient Graph Convolutional Networks for Point Cloud Handling
arxiv-2104-05706.creator: Yawei Li, He Chen, Zhaopeng Cui, Radu Timofte, Marc Pollefeys, Gregory Chirikjian, Luc Van Gool
arxiv-2104-05706.description: Abstract In this paper, we aim at improving the computational efficiency of graph convolutional networks (GCNs) for learning on point clouds. The basic graph convolution that is typically composed of a K K -nearest neighbor (KNN) search and a multilayer perceptron (MLP) is examined. By mathematically analyzing the operations there, two findings to improve the efficiency of GCNs are obtained.

arxiv-2202-02571.title: Minimum Ignition Energy of Methanol-Air Mixtures Journal: Combustion and Flame
arxiv-2202-02571.creator: Eduardo Fernández-Tarrazo, Mario Sánchez-Sanz, Antonio L. Sánchez, Forman A. Williams
arxiv-2202-02571.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Eduardo Fernández-Tarrazo, Mario Sánchez-Sanz, Antonio L. Sánchez, Forman A. Williams. A method for computing minimum ignition energies for gaseous fuel mixtures with detailed and reduced chemistry, by numerical integration of time-dependent conservation equations in a spherically symmetrical configuration, is presented and discussed, testing its general characteristics and accuracy. The method is applied to methanol-air mixtures described by a 38-step Arrhenius chemistry description and by an 8-step chemistry description based on steady-state approximations for reaction intermediaries.

arxiv-2210-15642.title: Existential definability over the subword ordering
arxiv-2210-15642.creator: Pascal Baumann ORCID:0000-0002-9371-0807, Moses Ganardi ORCID:0000-0002-0775-7781, Ramanathan S. Thinniyam ORCID:0000-0002-9926-0931, Georg Zetzsche ORCID:0000-0002-6421-4388
arxiv-2210-15642.description: Abstract . We study first-order logic (FO) over the structure consisting of finite words over some alphabet A A , together with the (non-contiguous) subword ordering. In terms of decidability of quantifier alternation fragments, this logic is well-understood: If every word is available as a constant, then even the Σ 1 \Sigma_{1} (i.e.

arxiv-2302-06901.title: C 60 \mathrm{C}_{60} + C 60 \mathrm{C}_{60} molecular bonding revisited and expanded
arxiv-2302-06901.creator: Jorge Laranjeira, Karol Strutyński, Leonel Marques, Emilio Martínez-Núñez, Manuel Melle-Franco
arxiv-2302-06901.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jorge Laranjeira, Karol Strutyński, Leonel Marques, Emilio Martínez-Núñez, Manuel Melle-Franco. Several dimerization products of fullerene C 60 \mathrm{C}_{60} are presented and thoroughly characterized with a quantum chemical DFT model augmented by dispersion. We reanalyze and expand significantly the number of known dimers from 12 to 41. Many of the novel bonding schemes were found by analyzing more than 2 nanoseconds of high energy molecular dynamics semiempirical trajectories with AutoMeKin, a methodology previously used to compute the reactivity of much smaller molecules.

arxiv-2302-09867.title: Motivic cohomology and K K -theory of some surfaces over finite fields
arxiv-2302-09867.creator: Oliver Gregory
arxiv-2302-09867.description: Abstract . We compute the algebraic K K -theory of some classes of surfaces defined over finite fields. We achieve this by first calculating the motivic cohomology groups and then studying the motivic Atiyah-Hirzebruch spectral sequence. In an appendix, we slightly enlarge the class of surfaces for which Parshin’s conjecture is known. 1.

arxiv-2307-10518.title: Interactive Segmentation for Diverse Gesture Types Without Context
arxiv-2307-10518.creator: Josh Myers-Dean, Yifei Fan, Brian Price, Wilson Chan, Danna Gurari
arxiv-2307-10518.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Josh Myers-Dean, Yifei Fan, Brian Price, Wilson Chan, Danna Gurari. Interactive segmentation entails a human marking an image to guide how a model either creates or edits a segmentation. Our work addresses limitations of existing methods: they either only support one gesture type for marking an image (e.g., either clicks or scribbles) or require knowledge of the gesture type being employed, and require specifying whether marked regions should be included versus excluded in the final segmentation.

arxiv-2311-02145.title: AdS black hole thermodynamics and microstructures from f ⁡ ( Q ) f(Q) gravitation
arxiv-2311-02145.creator: Oleksii Sokoliuk ID, Sneha Pradhan ID, Alexander Baransky ID, P.K. Sahoo ID
arxiv-2311-02145.description: Abstract The significant properties and phase transition of charged Anti-de Sitter (AdS) black holes have been extensively studied in a variety of modified theories of gravity in the presence of numerous matter fields. The goal of our current research is to investigate the AdS black hole’s thermodynamics under the impact of f ⁡ ( Q ) f(Q) gravity.

arxiv-2402-06410.title: Supplementary material for “Manifold-valued models for analysis of EEG time series data”
arxiv-2402-06410.creator: Tao Ding, Tom M. W. Nye, Yujiang Wang
arxiv-2402-06410.description: Abstract S1. Epilepsy data set The open-source data set analysed in this study is available from http://ieeg-swez.ethz.ch/ . The data set consists of EEG recordings for 18 patients (designated ID01 to ID18) who were part of the epilepsy surgery program.

arxiv-2406-17889.title: MITP/23-058 Matching the Weak Mixing Angle at Low Energies
arxiv-2406-17889.creator: Hubert Spiesberger, Stephan Wezorke, PRISMA Cluster of Excellence,Institute for Nuclear Physics and Institute of Physics,Johannes Gutenberg-University, 55099 Mainz, Germany
arxiv-2406-17889.description: Abstract The running weak mixing angle is used as a convenient tool to keep control of dominating logarithmic corrections in the Standard Model of the electroweak interactions connecting measurements at largely differing energy scales. To relate the solutions of the renormalization group equation for the weak mixing angle above and below particle thresholds one needs matching conditions.

arxiv-2502-19226.title: Light dilaton near critical points in top-down holography
arxiv-2502-19226.creator: Daniel Elander, Antón F. Faedo, Maurizio Piai, Ronnie Rodgers, Javier G. Subils
arxiv-2502-19226.description: Abstract We study a class of UV-complete, strongly coupled, confining three-dimensional field theories, that exhibit a novel stabilisation mechanism for the mass of the lightest scalar composite state, relying on the existence of a critical point. The theories admit a holographic dual description in terms of regular backgrounds in eleven-dimensional supergravity, which retains its rigorous microscopic interpretation in field theory.

arxiv-2503-03260.title: Quasinormal Modes and Topological Characteristics of a Schwarzschild Black Hole Surrounded by the Dehnen Type Dark Matter Halo
arxiv-2503-03260.creator: Farokhnaz Hosseinifar, Shahin Mamedov, Filip Studnička, Hassan Hassanabadi
arxiv-2503-03260.description: Abstract This study explores some properties of a black hole surrounded by a dark matter halo with a Dehnen-type density distribution. Specifically, we focus on the thermodynamic characteristics, shadow radius, quasinormal modes, and topological charge of thermodynamic potentials associated with this black hole.

arxiv-2506-09573.title: Probability-One Optimization of Generalized Rayleigh Quotient Sum For Multi-Source Generalized Total Least-Squares
arxiv-2506-09573.creator: Dominik Friml, Pavel Václavek
arxiv-2506-09573.description: Abstract This paper addresses the global optimization of the sum of the Rayleigh quotient and the generalized Rayleigh quotient on the unit sphere. While various methods have been proposed for this problem, they do not guarantee convergence to the global maximizer.

arxiv-2507-22023.title: Lightcurves of stars in the Chamaeleon I Association
arxiv-2507-22023.creator: K. Neumannová, L. Kueß, E. Paunzen, K. Bernhard
arxiv-2507-22023.description: Abstract Star-forming regions are essential for studying very young stellar objects of various masses. They still contain a significant amount of dust and gas. We present a study of light curves of stars in the field of the Chamaeleon I association.

arxiv-2606-02122.creator: Guoding Liu, Chushi Qin, Zitai Xu, Xiongfeng Ma, Zi-Wen Liu

britannica-1911-armstrong-john-diplomat.title: Armstrong, John (diplomat) (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-armstrong-john-diplomat.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-armstrong-john-diplomat.description: Article 'Armstrong, John (diplomat)' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 2), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. The best account of Armstrong’s career as minister to France and as secretary of war may be found in Henry Adams’s History of the United States, 1801–1817 (9 vols., New York, 1889–1890).

europmc-pmc9465902.title: Impact of low health literacy on patients' health outcomes: a multicenter cohort study.
europmc-pmc9465902.creator: Shahid R, Shoker M, Chu LM, Frehlick R, Ward H, Pahwa P.
europmc-pmc9465902.description: Background This study aims to assess the health literacy of medical patients admitted to hospitals and examine its correlation with patients' emergency department visits, hospital readmissions, and durations of hospital stay. Methods This prospective cohort study recruited patie

plos-pone-0012673.title: Single Nucleotide Polymorphisms in the Wnt and BMP Pathways and Colorectal Cancer Risk in a Spanish Cohort
plos-pone-0012673.creator: Ceres Fernández-Rozadilla, Luisa de Castro, Juan Clofent et al.
plos-pone-0012673.description: PLOS ONE research article. Colorectal cancer (CRC) is considered a complex disease, and thus the majority of the genetic susceptibility is thought to lie in the form of low-penetrance variants following a polygenic model of inheritance. Candidate-gene studies have so far been one of the basic approaches ta

pmc-11396552.title: The Relationship between Treatment Response and Overall Survival in Borderline, Non-Resectable and Resectable Pancreatic Cancer Patients Treated with Neoadjuvant FOLFIRINOX
pmc-11396552.creator: Alex Barenboim, Diego Mercer, Kapil Sahnan, Alex Gaffan, Or Goren, Sharon Halperin, Eli Brazowski, Sharon Pelles Avraham, Joseph M. Klausner, Nir Lubezky
pmc-11396552.description: Background: The National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN)-recommended treatment for patients with borderline-resectable pancreatic cancer (BRPC) and locally advanced pancreatic cancer (LAPC) involves a combination of neoadjuvant FOLFIRINOX chemotherapy and the curative surgical resection of the tumor. This study seeks to identify the clinical, radiological, laboratory, and pathologic predictors that can anticipate the oncological outcomes of patients.

pmc-12357350.title: CircRNAs: functions and emerging roles in cancer and immunotherapy
pmc-12357350.creator: Yan Wang, Yanru Cui, Xin Li, Su-Han Jin, Haitao Wang, Udo S Gaipl, Hu Ma, Shixiang Wang, Jian-Guo Zhou
pmc-12357350.description: BackgroundCircular RNAs (circRNAs) are emerging as promising tools in cancer and immunotherapy, with unique characteristics that offer potential therapeutic applications.Main bodyThis review outlines the discovery, biogenesis, and mechanisms of circRNAs, emphasizing their roles in cancer and immune regulation. CircRNAs modulate immune responses by acting as miRNA sponges, binding RNA-binding proteins, or serving as translation templates.

pmc-12410985.title: Nationalism in New Zealand Media During the COVID-19 Pandemic: A Mixed Methods Study
pmc-12410985.creator: Emma M R Anderson, Elizabeth Fenton, John A Crump
pmc-12410985.description: The COVID-19 pandemic has revealed the complex interplay between national self-interest and global cooperation. Media communication can contribute to the formation of national identity and promote nationalist themes, particularly in times of crisis. Media portrayals of the nation during a pandemic are informative, since nationalism, specifically health nationalism, may undermine the popular appetite for and effectiveness of global response efforts.

pmc-12658495.title: KRAS-targeted therapies in cancer: novel approaches and overcoming resistance
pmc-12658495.creator: Daolin Tang, Guido Kroemer, Rui Kang
pmc-12658495.description: KRAS, once considered undruggable, has become actionable across specific alleles, with KRAS-G12C inhibitors now approved and next-generation approaches—including pan-KRAS/pan-RAS inhibitors, targeted degraders and RNA-based strategies—progressing rapidly. However, clinical benefit remains limited due to the frequent emergence of resistance. Escape mechanisms include on-target secondary mutations, pathway reactivation, epithelial–mesenchymal transition, lineage plasticity and metabolic rewiring within an immunosuppressive tumour microenvironment.

pmc-12692071.title: Dysregulated Resolution of Inflammation After Respiratory Viral Infections: Molecular Pathways Linking Neuroinflammation to Post-Viral Neuropathic Pain—A Narrative Review
pmc-12692071.creator: Andrei Emilian Popa, Elena Popa, Tatiana Dramba, Elena Adorata Coman, Mihaela Poroch, Monica Ungureanu, Agnes Bacusca, Ana Maria Slanina, Gema Bacoanu, Vladimir Poroch, Andreas Beineke
pmc-12692071.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Post-viral neuroinflammatory syndromes, particularly those occurring after SARS-CoV-2 infection, have received increasing attention due to their complex and persistent neurological manifestations. The aim of this narrative review is to integrate current evidence on the molecular and cellular mechanisms underlying chronic neuroinflammation following viral infections, with a focus on dysregulated innate immune responses, macrophage–microglia interactions, oxidative–mitochondrial stress, and impaired inflammation resolution pathways.

pmc-12718548.title: Economic Burden of Respiratory Syncytial Virus Infection in Colombia: A Nationwide Cost-of-Illness Study
pmc-12718548.creator: Giancarlo Buitrago, Paula González-Caicedo, Juan M Reyes-Sanchez, Claudia Burgos, Jair Arciniegas, Jorge La Rotta, Omar Escobar, Andreina Alamo
pmc-12718548.description: BackgroundRespiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is one of the leading causes of acute respiratory infections and severe cases can lead to hospitalization or death. The epidemiology and health resource utilization of RSV infection in Colombia is not well understood. Given the recent availability of new RSV preventatives, this study estimated the economic burden of RSV in Colombia.

pmc-12756300.title: Single molecule nanopore counting assay targeting small extracellular vesicle cargo for non-invasive monitoring of cerebral organoid development and health
pmc-12756300.creator: S. M. Saiduzzaman, Ruiting Xu, Mohammad Julker Neyen Sampad, Ryan N. Hoffman, Spencer T. Seiler, Quinton Brail, Viktor Yurevych, Zachary J. Walker, Tanner N. Wells, Ephraim M. Ong, Thomas D. Yuzvinsky, Aaron R. Hawkins, Sofie R. Salama, Mircea Teodorescu, David Haussler, Holger Schmidt
pmc-12756300.description: Organoids are three-dimensional tissue cultures intended to replicate in vivo organs such that their function can be analyzed for applications in drug discovery, diagnostics, and research. This requires the ability to assess organoid health, development, and function on the cellular and molecular level, possibly frequently and over long periods of time.

pmc-13032870.title: Beyond Koch's postulates: the pathobiome paradigm in grapevine esca disease
pmc-13032870.creator: David Gramaje, Ales Eichmeier
pmc-13032870.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Esca is one of the most damaging fungal diseases of grapevine and continues to defy Koch's postulates. Although Phaeomoniella chlamydospora, Phaeoacremonium minimum, and Fomitiporia mediterranea are consistently associated with wood necrosis in esca-symptomatic vines, they also occur in asymptomatic vines and even in apparently healthy wood tissues without visible necrosis, and single-species but also mixed-species inoculations rarely reproduce the characteristic foliar symptoms.

pmc-13062484.title: The pH factor: unraveling drug-drug interactions in protein kinase inhibitors through the regulatory lens
pmc-13062484.creator: Simona Stankeviciute, Ariel Tsai, Noha Rayad, Matthias Kruse
pmc-13062484.description: Drug-drug interactions (DDIs) are a significant concern in clinical practice, DDIs might be relevant when drugs with pH-dependent solubility are co-administered with gastric acid-reducing agents (ARAs) such as histamine, H2-receptor antagonists and proton pump inhibitors. One class prone to such DDI at the absorption phase are the weakly basic protein kinase inhibitors (PKIs).

pmc-13069830.title: Extended hydrogen breath test analysis for optimized diagnosis of SIBO-positive IBS patients
pmc-13069830.creator: A Dahlgren, P Grybäck, H Jacobsson, PM Hellström
pmc-13069830.description: BackgroundSmall intestinal bacterial overgrowth (SIBO) is suggested in irritable bowel syndrome (IBS). Optimal hydrogen levels and time frame for diagnosing SIBO are still under discussion. Our primary aim was to consolidate a discriminating threshold for a positive lactulose hydrogen breath test (LHBT) in IBS. As a secondary aim, we optimized the diagnostic time frame for the small bowel.

pmc-13181909.title: Prediction models for CAR-T Cell therapy-related adverse events in hematologic malignancies: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13181909.creator: Linrui Ye, Luqing Liao, Lulu Wang, Xuejian Zhao, Jitao Zeng, Xuehu Xu
pmc-13181909.description: BackgroundIdentifying patients at high risk of adverse events is crucial in chimeric antigen receptor T-cell (CAR-T) therapy to enable early intervention. Despite the development of numerous prediction models, their methodological quality and performance remain systematically unassessed.MethodsWe conducted a systematic search across seven databases and Google Scholar, covering all records up to October 29, 2025.

pmc-13317517.title: Dynamic bilateral vertebral artery occlusion owing to os odontoideum mimicking basilar artery occlusion: illustrative case
pmc-13317517.creator: Takao Morita, Wataru Matsushita, Tomohiro Okuda, Yasuhito Ikeuchi, Tomoya Shibahara, Nobuo Kobara, Takahiro Kuwashiro, Hiroshi Sugimori, So Tokunaga
pmc-13317517.description: BACKGROUNDAcute vertebrobasilar occlusion is most commonly thromboembolic and requires emergency endovascular therapy (EVT). However, upper cervical instability may rarely cause neck motion-dependent dynamic vertebral artery (VA) occlusion. Os odontoideum is a recognized cause of atlantoaxial instability that has been associated with bow hunter syndrome; however, acute bilateral VA occlusion mimicking basilar artery occlusion (BAO) is exceedingly uncommon.

pmc-13503932.title: Dynamic energy-aware fixed-point linear mapping multiplier for internet of things edge devices
pmc-13503932.creator: Dongling Wu, Likun Zhao, Bonghwan Kim, Junjie Yin, Jierui Xue
pmc-13503932.description: Approximate computing has emerged as an effective approach for reducing power consumption in error-tolerant applications, particularly in resource-constrained Internet of Things (IoT) edge systems. However, most existing approximate multipliers employ static approximation levels, limiting their ability to adapt to dynamically varying energy conditions at runtime.

pmc-13561961.title: T cells are blind to the dark mechanics of tumors
pmc-13561961.creator: Marco Fritzsche, Karsten Kruse
pmc-13561961.description: Significance StatementT cell surveillance depends on the mechanical context of antigen presentation. Aberrant tumor elasticity and viscosity compromise T cell receptor signaling. We introduce ‘dark mechanics’, proposing that cancer cells exploit these altered viscoelastic properties to escape the mechanosensitive window necessary for T cell activation.
